purpose: Digests the provenance guard cannot resolve because the bytes are deliberately not committed. Registering one is a visible act: it states which bytes are missing and why, so an unresolvable digest is never permitted in silence. A digest that is simply wrong does not belong here - it belongs deleted.

digests.why_not_committed: repository policy excludes market-data cache; the panel was delivered by file upload and never committed
digests.consequence: the selection arithmetic in docs/real_data_evidence/ re-derives from committed artefacts, but the backtests behind it cannot be reproduced here without obtaining a CSV that hashes to this value
